clusters.mechanism: Truncation overlap dropped after a runner cut uses literal credential lengths, but JSON-escaped variants are longer, so a suffix of a cut escaped credential survives redaction.
runProcess's line splitter drops blank lines, so multiline credentials containing blank lines are altered before reassembly and no longer match redaction in failure excerpts.
Removing the per-line 8,000-character slice leaves retained diagnostic lines unbounded in memory.
Per-line redaction replaces a shorter registered credential inside a longer multiline credential, so the assembled text no longer matches the longer credential and its other lines leak.
loadOutputPrivacy withholds any text containing the literal "[redacted]", hiding already-redacted or benign text in MCP and digest output.
confinementError is now always written as false and treated as authoritative, reversing the documented compatibility choice for older readers and strict schemas.

redactGateData is applied globally to API responses, SSE messages, artifacts, run state, prompts and reports, which strips control characters from non-gate data, adds confinementError to unrelated objects, and exceeds the requested single redaction point.
The artifact endpoint parses and re-serializes JSON artifacts without indentation, so pretty-printed artifacts are served minified.
